_note: Ventures: dawn cards that spend tribespeople for goods (sim/people.gd _venture_card, RunState.choose_pick). At each dawn, with chance venture_chance (data/balance.json), one of the dawn cards is a venture of the town's age or earlier (age: the first age it can come up in), in place of a newcomer, if the town has at least send + venture_keep_home tribespeople. Taking it sends send tribespeople out; a number between lose[0] and lose[1] (rolled when taken) never come back, the rest return at once. gain: goods brought home, grown by venture_growth_per_round for every round past the first (rounded up). Relic keys: venture_safety (each venture loses that many fewer, never below 0), venture_bonus (share more goods). rarity (data/rarity.json): the colour of the venture's dawn card.

warthog_cull.name: Cull the warthogs
warthog_cull.text: The warthogs are rooting up the berry patches. Drive them off and bring the meat home.

timber_float.name: Float timber downriver
timber_float.text: Fell the tall pines upstream and ride them down the white water.

far_cliffs.name: Climb the far cliffs
far_cliffs.text: Good stone and flint lie under the cliffs where the vultures nest.

fire_the_brush.name: Fire the brushland
fire_the_brush.text: Set the dry hills alight and gather the charred wood. The fire does not always go where it is told.

tin_trek.name: Trek to the tin hills
tin_trek.text: Ore lies in the hills past the dens. Not everyone walks back.

herd_raid.name: Raid the hill clan's herds
herd_raid.text: Take their cattle in the night. They will fight for them.

margraves_levy.name: Answer the margrave's levy
margraves_levy.text: Send young folk to serve in a lord's war far away. They will not come home, but the lord pays well.
